In [6]:
rgb_latent_scale_factor = depth_latent_scale_factor = 0.18215

def encode_rgbd(x_in: torch.Tensor):
    if x_in.shape[1] == 1:
        x_in = x_in.repeat(1, 3, 1, 1)
    # encode
    # x_in: (5, 3, H, W)
    h = vae.encoder(x_in)
    # h: (5, 8, H/8, W/8)
    moments = vae.quant_conv(h)
    # moments shape = h
    mean, logvar = torch.chunk(moments, 2, dim=1)
    # 4, 4
    # scale latent
    latent = mean * rgb_latent_scale_factor
    return latent


def decode_depth(depth_latent: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    # scale latent
    depth_latent = depth_latent / depth_latent_scale_factor
    # decode
    z = vae.post_quant_conv(depth_latent)
    # z, depth_latent: (5, 4, H/8, W/8)
    stacked = vae.decoder(z)
    # stacked: (5, 3, H, W)
    # mean of output channels
    depth_mean = stacked.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    return depth_mean


def decode_rgb(rgb_latent: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    rgb_latent = rgb_latent / rgb_latent_scale_factor
    # decode
    z = vae.post_quant_conv(rgb_latent)
    # z, depth_latent: (5, 4, H/8, W/8)
    rgb = vae.decoder(z)
    # stacked: (5, 3, H, W)
    # mean of output channels
    return rgb

def align_depth(pred_dpt, ref_dpt):
    # align with RANSAC

    degree = 1
    poly_features = PolynomialFeatures(degree=degree, include_bias=False)
    ransac = RANSACRegressor(max_trials=1000)
    model = make_pipeline(poly_features, ransac)

    mask = ref_dpt > 1e-8

    if mask.sum() < 10:
        print('no enough samples')
        return None, None
    
    gt_mask = ref_dpt[mask]
    pred_mask = pred_dpt[mask]
    if len(gt_mask.shape) == 1:
        gt_mask = gt_mask.reshape(-1, 1)
    if len(pred_mask.shape) == 1:
        pred_mask = pred_mask.reshape(-1, 1)
    
    model.fit(pred_mask, gt_mask)
    a, b = model.named_steps['ransacregressor'].estimator_.coef_, model.named_steps['ransacregressor'].estimator_.intercept_
    
    assert a > 0
    pred_metric = a * pred_dpt + b
    
    return pred_metric, a, b
